item.title: Week 10: Bills at Jets
item.description: Sun 11/15 · 1:00 PM ET | Line: BUF -8.5 · O/U 50.5 | Model NYJ 33% vs. market 20% | The game likely turns on whether Buffalo's passing game, which posts +0.17 EPA per dropback, can exploit a Jets defense ranked 31st against the pass. Khalil Shakir creates 4.4 yards of separation, second-best of any receiver, and he runs into that same secondary. Our model has Buffalo at 67% against the market's 80%, with the passing matchup as the biggest driver of our number.
